Tyler’s likelihood of improving depends on whether he attributes his failure to factors he can control and change.  
Option (D) involves self-critique and adjusting study methods, which reflects a *growth mindset* and internal, controllable factors — this is linked to better academic improvement over time.  
The other options involve externalizing blame or assuming future tests will be easier without personal change, which are less likely to lead to improvement.  

Final answer: (D)
